episodes.text: 2026-07-07: Riya Malhotra asked to unsubscribe from promo senders she never opens (last 30 days, 134 messages from 12 senders). Background task t-7712 unsubscribing and archiving 8 senders: Crate & Barrel, Wayfair, HelloFresh, Old Navy, Uber marketing, Sephora, Cineplex, Best Buy. Kept Chapters, Duolingo, Lululemon, Notion.

2026-07-07: Reminder evt_9f31c2 Wed 8 Jul 12:00 to renew library books (due Thu). Toronto Hydro July bill $142.18 ready, auto-pay Jul 21. Riya texted Hannah Cho thanks for garden zucchini (fritters, Leo ate them). Pun notes from 2026-06-30: chemistry puns for Sam's end-of-year card for his students; Hannah may reuse for Ellie's teacher card.

2026-07-07: Riya's cousin Neha has two Calgary job offers (one pays $15k more with 50-min commute each way; other 10 min away, fully hybrid); assistant leaned toward the hybrid one. Leo sleepwalked a lap of the hallway recently.

2026-07-09: Riya, Sam and Leo landed in Vancouver and are at Kabir Malhotra's. Earlier flight search (note 2026-07-03): Toronto-Vancouver Air Canada AC 113, $486 return per person economy, Jul 9-13. Translation of chorus of Natalia Lafourcade's 'Hasta la Raíz' (from 2026-06-24) retrieved for Mei: 'I carry you inside, down to the root / and however much I grow, you'll be here'; not yet sent to Mei.

2026-07-09: Electrician can come Monday after all; Riya asked the assistant to notify the kitchen crew and find a time, but assistant needs to know whom to contact and how (open). Leo found a crab in a tide pool at the seawall and named it Steve.

2026-07-09: Vancouver planning: Kitsilano Beach Park playground (partial shade, washrooms at concession) for Fri 10 Jul morning, backup Connaught Park; Museum of Vancouver (Vanier Park) open Fri 10am-9pm, kids $12 adults $22; Kitsilano Pool open daily 7:00-20:45 weekdays, lanes closed 7-9 Fri, child $3.70 adult $7.40. Thank-you card drafted for Kabir's neighbours who lent an air mattress and pack and play.

2026-07-09: Riya renting a car Saturday in Vancouver; fine print flagged: fuel $9.49/L + $25 fee if not full, LDW $32.99/day (check credit card coverage), cleaning fee up to $250 for sand, $350 deposit hold, unlimited km in BC/WA/OR.

2026-07-09: After a 40 min bag wait at YVR and forgetting Leo's swim shirt and stuffie, Riya set new packing rules (note 'Packing rules'): carry-on only for trips under a week; shared packing checklist for Leo prepared three days before departure. Created shared note 'Leo packing - Vancouver return Jul 13' (swim shirt, stuffie Rexy, tablet and charger, pyjamas, toothbrush, snacks, headphones, colouring book), shared with Sam Okafor.
2026-07-12: Kitchen reno update from Sam: electrical panel upgraded to 200 A, reno budget raised to $56,000, contingency used up; 'kitchen reno' note updated.

2026-07-12: Leo's birthday present confirmed: Indigo order #IND-778120 (LEGO Jurassic World T. rex set, $99.99, free standard shipping) confirmed 2026-07-08, delivery July 15, 2026 to Leslieville, two days before his birthday. Expenses note: 2026-07-11 dim sum lunch near Kitsilano with Kabir and Mei (personal).

2026-07-13: Riya's out-of-office set to end Tue 14 Jul 08:00 with message that she is back but catching up. Rental car return at YVR (full tank): 22 min drive via Granville St and Arthur Laing Bridge; Petro-Canada at 3500 Grant McConachie Way 2 min from lot. Flight home delayed 40 min.

2026-07-13: Lisbon flight search (note 2026-07-10) Toronto YYZ to LIS, Dec 18-30 round trip, direct: TAP $1,284 per adult; Air Canada $1,412; Air Transat $1,096 (no seat selection); child fares about 75% on TAP and Air Canada. Trip spend Jul 9-13 on TD Visa $1,186.40.

2026-07-13: Family group chat while flying: Kabir says Leo left a sock at theirs and will mail it; Riya's mom asked for naming ceremony photos, Kabir added her to the album; mom thinks Ira looks like Riya as a baby.

2026-07-13: Library: renewed Leo's 3 items to 2026-08-04 (DK Dinosaur Encyclopedia, Dog Man: Twenty Thousand Fleas Under the Sea, The Bad Guys #3); 'Owl Diaries: Eva's Big Sleepover' has holds, due Thu 16 Jul; reminder evt_b2a071 Wed 15 Jul 17:30 to return it. Reminder 'Book date-night dinner (Sat 18 Jul)' has no reservation yet; Riya said she'll deal with it tomorrow.

2026-07-13: Riya's heel hurts after walking in Vancouver; advised rest from running this weekend; assistant has no notes on her running buddy. Air Canada delay of 40 min: no compensation (below 3 hours).

2026-07-14: Riya booked Lisbon flights on TAP from Toronto Pearson, leaving 2026-12-18, back 2026-12-30; family calendar all-day event evt_c40d88 'Lisbon trip' 18-30 Dec; background task t-7790 watching for TAP confirmation to add flight times. TAP charge $3,442.80 on the TD Visa (pending, Visa travel insurance applies).

2026-07-14: Passport check for Lisbon (Portugal needs 3 months validity past 30 Dec, i.e. until at least 30 Mar 2027): Riya expires 2030-05-14, Sam Okafor 2028-11-02, Leo Okafor 2027-02-20. Leo's passport must be renewed before the trip; child renewal about 20 business days by mail, start in August.

2026-07-14: TAP baggage: car seat or booster per child checked free in addition to allowance; power banks carry-on only. Time difference: Lisbon 5 hours ahead of Toronto in December. Riya's coworker Jasmine's landlord proposed 8% rent increase for a 2015 Toronto building (above guideline requires LTB approval).
2026-07-26: Riya's best friend from McGill, Priya Nair, moved back to Toronto in July 2026 and lives in Roncesvalles; architect at a new firm on Spadina; contact updated.

2026-07-26: Instant Payouts general availability moved to 2026-11-04 because Wavecrest Bank's partner certification slipped by seven weeks; Tom Becker knows. Search found no public Wavecrest certification timeline; suggested asking Wavecrest's partner manager or Aisha Rahman.
2026-07-26: Lisbon December stay reserved: two-bedroom Airbnb apartment in Alfama near Miradouro de Santa Luzia for the whole stay (reserved Jul 26); added to 'Lisbon Dec 2026' note.

2026-08-06: Biscuit's boarding plan for Lisbon in December: Dogs Den Kennels, Scarborough; quote 2 Aug: 13 nights Dec 17-30, 2026, $598 plus tax, two walks a day, private run, valid 30 days (until about 1 Sep); needs bordetella and rabies certificates at drop-off. Dates not yet held. Hannah Cho's backyard pool party Mon 3 Aug; Leo wants to ride Lisbon trams (route 28 through Alfama).

2026-08-07: Home insurance renewal HO-4471823, term 2026-09-01 to 2027-09-01: premium $1,640 to $1,812 (+$172, +10.5%); dwelling limit $870,000; deductible $1,000; sewer backup and overland water $25,000 unchanged; new exclusion for damage by contractors without liability insurance; new condition to notify insurer of renovations over $25,000 within 30 days (relevant to the kitchen reno). Auto-renews Sep 1. Weekend note 'Weekend Aug 8-9' includes call insurer about the renovation clause.

2026-08-07: Weekend checklist 'Weekend Aug 8-9': call insurer about reno clause, return library books, gift for Sunday birthday party, fix squeaky gate, pick up dry cleaning, book oil change; plus fall picks for Sam: Evergreen Brick Works Harvest Festival (Sep 12-13, free), Doors Open (Sep 26-27), Nuit Blanche family zone (Oct 3), Downeys pumpkin patch (Oct 10-12, $15pp), Boo at the Zoo (Oct 24-25, tickets Sep 15). Next yard waste Thu 13 Aug and Thu 27 Aug.
2026-08-07: Aisha Rahman opened PAY-1241 and PAY-1242 for Wavecrest certification follow-ups. Sam's cousin Chidi's dog ate grapes; assistant advised calling a vet or pet poison line immediately.

2026-08-07: Reminder evt_d77e10 Mon 10 Aug 10:00 to book Leo's eye exam (school note); Eye See Eye Learn free exams cover JK to grade 1 only, so Leo (Grade 2) is not eligible. Sam put the green bin and recycling out. TD Visa statement closes Aug 8, balance $4,927.13 including TAP flights, auto-paid in full.
